To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) students’ learning can be significantly increased if teachers use formative assessments to give them frequent feedback on their progress; (2) the feedback needs to be specific and focused on students’ understanding of particular concepts and skills; (3) students’ learning will not increase if they are not given the opportunity to act on the information they receive; (4) students’ learning is likely to be enhanced if they are involved in setting their own learning goals, in self- or peer-assessment
the students who received more feedback on their work and more opportunities to reflect on it did better than the other students in our study.
formative assessment is a powerful means of raising student achievement and that the most powerful single factor in improving formative assessment practice is teacher training.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of theoretical and practical models for the assessment of students’ learning in the classroom and in the school.
the development of a theoretical framework that is grounded in empirical research on the nature of formative assessment.
the nature of feedback and the development of theoretical frameworks to underpin formative assessment practice.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are strong indications of the effectiveness of formative assessment and that the research base is sufficiently well established to warrant the implementation of formative assessment in schools.
the evidence is strong that formative assessment can make a substantial contribution to learning.
formative assessment is the most powerful influence on student learning that a teacher can use in an average classroom.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
formative assessment is a process of gathering information from learners in order to improve their learning and their teaching.
we have been able to show that the use of formative assessment can have a significant impact on student achievement.
formative assessment has been shown to have a powerful effect on students' learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
students need to be taught how to self-assess.
formative assessment works best when teachers are actively involved in the process.
students are capable of providing useful information about their learning.
